content:
Priya: Heads-up — cutoff for v1.13 is ~48h from now. Can we create release/1.13 branch by EOD tomorrow? Need to lock changelog and open cherry-pick window. CC @Alex

Alex: On it. Quick Q — policy for non-critical backports? Allow doc-only and perf fixes, or docs-only + bugfixes?

Priya: Docs-only ok after branch. Bugfixes require release-owner approval and green tests. Label backports with `backport/1.13`. Include the original issue link.

Jorge: I can open the branch once CI is green. Any manual steps I should follow? I remember bumping version files.

Priya: Yep — bump in `pkg/version.go` + update `infra/helm/values.yaml` docker tag. I can do the version bump if you want.

Alex: Prefer you do the bump; I will prep the changelog PR. Also add a short migration note for the KV-cache key rename.

release-manager: FYI I updated the canary rollout plan doc with the new timing — https://redwood.internal/docs/release-canary (internal).

Sam: small thing — redeploy job sometimes blocks branch creation because e2e queue is full. @CI-bot can you reserve a slot?

CI-bot: Booked e2e slot for `branch-creation` at 10:30 PST tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

Priya: For cherry-picks: please use the `cherry-pick-request` template in PR body and ping @release-manager for approval. Mention perf owner if touching runtime.

Alex: Templated commands I use for branch creation (copy/paste):

```
git checkout -b release/1.13
# bump version files
git add pkg/version.go infra/helm/values.yaml
git commit -m "release/1.13: bump versions"
git push origin release/1.13
# create repo-level metadata if needed
gh api repos/redwood/release-branches -X POST -f name='release/1.13'
```

Jorge: Thanks — I'll wait for the branch and then run backports into `backport/1.13/*` branches.

release-manager: Note: if a backport touches runtime scheduling or kernel selection, tag @eng-ml for perf regression checks.

Priya: Timeline recap: branch created by 2026-03-18 18:00 UTC; feature freeze 2026-03-19 00:00 UTC. If no objections I'll post a reminder tomorrow morning.

Alex: :thumbsup: no objections from me.

Sam: I'll monitor e2e queue and ping here if anything blocks.

Priya: Great — thanks everyone, will follow up with the branch PR link once created.
